title: The Master terminal fills the page every time it is opened, for typing and read-only viewers
description: A real browser against the served dashboard with a host-side herdr stub whose master pane is laid out at 70 columns: at 1280 px and at 390 px, on first open, after navigating away and back and after a reconnect, the pane's drawing spans the terminal container's width (its last column within one character cell of the right edge) and its rows fill the height, for a typing viewer and for a read-only viewer; the read-only viewer still cannot send input, and the Master page document does not scroll.

steps.name: Open the Master terminal at both widths as a typing and a read-only viewer
